entries.finding: Galaxy cluster WHL0137-08: Webb NIRCam, 0.9 to 4.4 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red; 610 × 830 px over 12.22 arcsec. The file's embedded tags give 0.02003 arcsec per pixel and north 17.2° left of vertical, and place the paper's position at pixel 4914, 4194, on the arc. The same publisher's tags placed another galaxy 1.5 arcsec off (JADES-GS-z14-0), so that place is good to about an arcsec. The window holds the whole arc; only a band along it is kept, 0.44 arcsec to each side of a path traced by eye over the arc and fading out over a further 0.28 arcsec, so the nearer cluster's galaxies around it are not drawn.
